## Summary

[Partial] Run a single wire from the battery to an inline fuse holder and connect one power stud. [t170]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Run a single 6-gauge primary wire from the battery to an inline fuse holder.
2. Connect one power stud on the auxiliary panel to this main feed.

## Tools

- Metripack crimper [t170]

## Parts

- Auxiliary Fuse Panel, e.g., Bussmann RTMR: Features bussed fuses and relay sockets [t170]
- [Partial] Inline fuse holder: Rated for 100 amps or similar high capacity [t170]
- Metripack 280 series female pins: For connecting wires to the panel backside [t170]

## Tips & gotchas

- Create a diagram of your layout before crimping. [t170]
- Use dielectric grease on fuses if located in damp areas. [t170]
